# Interior of AI

> AI-powered interior design: upload a room photo or describe a space and get photorealistic redesigns in seconds. A product of AvailableView LLC.

Interior of AI generates interior design concepts across styles such as modern, Scandinavian, industrial, minimalist, bohemian and mid-century. Users can generate designs, browse a public gallery, and buy credits or subscribe for more generations.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the AI interior design platform, how it works, and sample transformations.
- [Generate](/generate): Create an AI interior design by choosing a style and room type.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Browse AI-generated interior designs from the community, filtered by style.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free plan, credit packs, and subscription tiers.
- [Contact](/contact): Support, partnership, and enterprise enquiries.
